EMPLOYEE SURVIVAL GUIDE

How to clock out.

01 · Cubicle
Follow the report checklist, then read each colleague’s clue and choose a useful reply.

02 · HR patrol
Use arrow keys, WASD or the buttons. HR moves once per step or wait. Orange tiles are watched. Walls block movement; invalid moves cost no turn.

03 · Boss chase
Left/right switches lanes. Space or Jump clears a low paper stack for that wave. Filing cabinets must be dodged. Three hits and you’re booked into a meeting.

Pause freezes the chase. Calm mode slows it down. You can replay any act from the tabs.
